test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Select the sentence that has the correct use of spellings from the given options.**

options.text: In spite of the challenges possed by the pandamic, the company adapted to remote work and successfully maintained productivity levels.
In spite of the challenges posed by the pandamic, the company adapted to remote work and successfuly maintained productvity levels.
In spite of the challenges posed by the pandemic, the company adapted to remote work and successfully maintained productivity levels.
In spite of the challenges possed by the pandemic, the company adapted to remote work and succesfully maintained productevity levels.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**In spite of the challenges posed by the pandemic, the company adapted to remote work and successfully maintained productivity levels.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**challenges**" - A noun referring to difficulties or obstacles that require effort to overcome.
 
• "**posed**" - The past tense of the verb "pose," meaning to present or create a part
